text_block_list.text:
At dusk. Walking on the way back to Tracen 
Academy—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Huh? There's a huge crowd up ahead! What's 
going on?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trouble... Surely that can't be it. I've 
been steering clear of any unlucky paths, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
A lottery~♪ Ah, Trainer! Look at the shape 
of that raffle wheel!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't it look just like a Bagua diagram? 
A picture-perfect octagon☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Maybe the raffle lottery originated from 
feng shui!

There's no proof. But it might have a 
connection to omikuji or Shinto.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Did the lottery call to us? Or did we seek 
it out? I don't know the cause. But still!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Now that we've met like this, there's no 
backing down, right?♪ Lend me a hand, 
Trainer.

And so, gripping the raffle wheel's lever 
together with Copano Rickey—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Fortune is in the hands of the gods! 
Lottery, reveal our destiny to us!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaah!!

"We spin the raffle drum together. And the 
result is—"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Wah☆ Yaaaaay!!!!! I can't believe it's the 
grand prize, this is way too awesome--!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
This surely isn't a coincidence, but a 
revelation of destiny. In other words—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Go to the hot springs, absorb plenty of 
the earth's power dissolved in the water, 
and put it to good use for everyone's 
sake... Seems that's what it means♪"
choice_data_list:
Alright, let's get that reservation in 
right away...

Alright, then let's get that reservation 
in right away...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Wait! I'd really love to, but... Feng 
shui has a teaching about hot springs."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"They say, 'If you soak in an auspicious 
hot spring in March, you'll never lack 
fine kimonos for the rest of your life.'"
choice_data_list:
Kimono... does that mean you don't have to 
worry about Western clothes?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"No. Kimonos represent all kinds of 
wealth. In other words, if you want to be 
wealthy in the future, I think going in 
March is best."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But around that time this year, your 
schedule is already packed, right? There 
are big races right before and after, 
too...

You're right about that. At times like 
this—
choice_data_list:
Guess we'll wait for the dragon veins to 
settle.

Shall we wait for the dragon veins to 
settle?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right! Feng shui-wise, that's 
the correct move☆ After making it safely 
through the turbulent season—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
In other words, taking our time to realign 
our meridians together next March would be 
ideal, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Fufu, fufufufu☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well, I just couldn't resist~. Say 
what you will, but, well... it's a hot 
springs trip, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Once all this hard work is done, I'm gonna 
play a whole bunch! Rickey☆ Lucky☆ Super 
Happy♪☆★

I cannot hide my overflowing joy. I will 
build up my achievements so we can proudly 
go out next year.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Wow, incredible☆ This might be a pretty 
lucky food!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, whoever came up with this Salisbury 
steak might actually be well-versed in 
feng shui.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Look, take a close look at the prize. 
Right in the middle of the dark brown 
meat, an orange carrot is shoved right in, 
see?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"This greatly improves the flow of qi. It 
boosts your fortune, and what's more—"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Packed with nutrition! Eat something like 
this, and you're guaranteed to feel 
energized from the bottom of your tummy☆"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Plus, eating happily together with good 
friends makes it super happy♪ Trainer, 
let's head back and eat, eat!☆"

A hamburger steak packed with both good 
fortune and nutrition. The lucky food gave 
Copano Rickey quite a burst of spirit.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, with this much of it, the sheer 
pressure of the colors is incredible!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
A carrot... Orange... It really is orange, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah, before we eat!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Trainer, can you lend me your room 
for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that oughta do it. If I leave it by 
the front door before eating, then—!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's guaranteed to invite good energy in! 
After all, the entryway is where good 
fortune comes in from♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but it might be better if the "Lucky 
Zone," the pathway of good fortune, was 
tidied up a bit more.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, before we eat, I'll clean up the 
room too♪ It's my specialty, so leave it 
to me!

And so, in her freshly cleaned room, she 
ate plenty of carrots. Strangely enough, 
they tasted twice as delicious.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: A single carrot?! Could this be...!!
choice_data_list: Is it bad feng shui or something?
Is it bad according to feng shui?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yeah! But I only got one, you know?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's so disappointing, and seriously 
frustrating, isn't it?!

"I have a feeling feng shui didn't really 
have much to do with it. It felt like 
purely an emotional issue."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Jokes aside... things are definitely 
heading in a bad direction. I should 
probably stay on guard.
(Bzzzt!)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Trainer, car! Watch out!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
See? Good and bad fortune can reveal 
themselves in the smallest of things.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Let's just head home quietly today. And 
try not to move around too much.

On days when things are on a downward 
trend, it's best not to overdo anything. 
We split a carrot, ate it, and went to bed 
early.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tissues... This might seem like a 
disappointment, but still...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
From a feng shui perspective, it actually 
has quite a few uses.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You know how things get damp and dreary 
when there isn't enough fresh air 
circulating?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Because tissues can be used to banish such 
evil humidity and moisture. For example—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...Like when I have to wipe away my tears 
of frustration. Waaaah...

Though she claimed she wasn't 
disappointed, it was clear that she was. 
She could wipe away her tears, but not the 
sting of defeat.
